abilities.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
abilities.description: As a bonus action, Halric casts *bless*, *dispel magic*, *healing word*, or *lesser restoration*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Halric makes two attacks: one with Mace and one with Radiant Flame. It can replace one attack with a use of Rallying Shout.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Rallying Shout
actions.description: Each creature of Halric's choice within 30 feet of him must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or immediately move up to half its speed in a direction of Halric's choice, using the safest available route.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
Halric casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): -

At will: *light*, *thaumaturgy*

1/day each: *spirit guardians*
